title: Direction-Dependent Rotation Error and Calibration Trade-offs in Sparse-IMU Gait Estimation
description: Reproducibility archive for the study of direction-dependent sensor-frame rotation error and calibration trade-offs in sparse-IMU gait estimation. It contains the frozen derived virtual-IMU dataset (747 gait cycles; 138 participants), original Ridge model code and reproduction evidence, external Camargo physical-IMU result summaries (248 windows; 19 participants), and additional analyses of augmentation-seed and participant-partition variability, physical-model tuning, local-axis sensitivity, matched relative rotations, and disjoint calibration. Random-axis averages can conceal marked direction-dependent errors. Mathematical coordinate-frame rotations do not establish tolerance to physical sensor remounting. Original raw Camargo HDF5 recordings are publicly available from the source provider and are not redistributed.

creators.name: Lima Júnior, Sérgio de Nazaré Rodrigues
